designSystem.title: Design tokens
designSystem.intro: Colours, type, buttons and states used across the app.
designSystem.typographySample: Sunday soup, fresh bread and a full pantry

planner.title: Plan this week
planner.description: Drag dishes from the tray or ask the agent for proposals. You accept them with one click.
planner.agentHint: Ask Claude: "Plan next week's dinners in Pantry."

recipes.title: Add your first recipe
recipes.description: Type it in, or give the agent a link to a recipe page and it will copy it and match the ingredients.
recipes.agentHint: Ask Claude: "Add the recipe from this link to Pantry."

shopping.title: Everything is in the cart
shopping.description: Nothing left to buy. A new list comes from the plan when you need one.

firstRun.label: First run
firstRun.title: Let's set up Pantry
firstRun.intro: This account will be the admin. Then you can invite the rest of the household.
firstRun.hint: No password. The passkey stays in your phone's password manager.

cancelled.title: Passkey creation cancelled.
cancelled.body: The passkey window was closed. Try again.

failed.title: The passkey could not be saved.
failed.body: Check the connection and try again.

unsupported.title: Passkeys do not work here.
unsupported.body: Open the app over HTTPS in an up-to-date browser.

alreadyDone.title: Pantry is already set up
alreadyDone.body: Someone else finished the first run. Ask them for an invite.

done.title: Welcome home!
done.body: Your passkey is saved on this device. Next time a fingerprint or your face is enough.

household.title: Household
household.notBuiltYet: This part of the settings is still being built.

language.title: Content language
language.description: The language the agent writes in

members.intro: The portion factor says how much each member eats. Their sum is the household serving, which sets the shopping quantities.
members.bounds: Portion factor from {{min}} to {{max}}, in steps of {{step}}.
members.loadFailed: Members could not be loaded. Check the connection.
members.saveFailed: The change was not saved. Check the connection and try again.
members.confirmRemoveUser: Remove the account of {{name}}? The member stays.
members.lastAdmin: The last admin has to stay. Make someone else an admin first.

invite.title: Invite for {{name}}
invite.body: Send this link only to this person. They open it on their phone and create a passkey.

recovery.title: Recovery link for {{name}}
recovery.body: Send this link only to this person. They open it on the new phone and add a passkey.

issued.note: The link works for 48 hours and only once. A new link cancels this one.

slots.intro: Meals are the rows of the plan. A disabled meal leaves the plan, but its history stays.
slots.inPlanCount: Meals a day in the plan: {{count}}.
slots.lastEnabled: At least one meal stays in the plan.
slots.loadFailed: Meals could not be loaded. Check the connection.
slots.saveFailed: The change was not saved. Check the connection and try again.

signIn.title: Pantry
signIn.intro: Meal plan and shopping for the whole household.
signIn.hint: No account? Ask the admin for an invite.
signIn.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.

cancelled.title: Sign-in interrupted.
cancelled.body: The passkey window was closed or the passkey does not match this address. Try again or ask the admin for a new link.

rejected.title: This passkey is not known here.
rejected.body: It may have been removed. Ask the admin for a new link.

failed.title: Could not sign in.
failed.body: Check the connection and try again.

unsupported.title: Passkeys do not work here.
unsupported.body: Open the app over HTTPS in an up-to-date browser.

loadFailed.title: The link could not be opened.
loadFailed.body: Check the connection and try again.

recovery.label: Recovery link
recovery.title: Get back into Pantry, {{name}}
recovery.body: Create a passkey on this device. Passkeys on your other devices keep working.

redeemLink.hint: No password. The passkey stays in your phone's password manager.

cancelled.title: Passkey creation cancelled.
cancelled.body: The passkey window was closed. Try again.

failed.title: The passkey could not be saved.
failed.body: Check the connection and try again.

unsupported.title: Passkeys do not work here.
unsupported.body: Open the app over HTTPS in an up-to-date browser.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Links work for 48 hours. Ask the admin for a new one.

used.title: This link was already used
used.body: Each link works only once. If it was not you, tell the admin.

revoked.title: This link was cancelled
revoked.body: The admin cancelled it or sent a newer one. Ask for a new link.

notFound.title: This link does not work
notFound.body: Check that the whole address was copied, or ask the admin for a new link.

done.title: Welcome home!
done.body: Your passkey is saved on this device. Next time a fingerprint or your face is enough.
